shortDescription.text: Code quality metric exceeds configured architectural threshold.
Deployment job executes without an upstream test gate in its needs chain.

help.text: Add a 'needs:' dependency on a test or verification job before executing deployment steps.

shortDescription.text: Workflow installs dependencies without caching configured.

help.text: Enable built-in caching on setup-* actions (e.g., cache: 'pip' or 'npm') or add an explicit actions/cache step.

shortDescription.text: Multi-job build and deploy workflow lacks artifact handoff.

help.text: Publish immutable build outputs with actions/upload-artifact or push signed container images before deploying.

shortDescription.text: Workflow chains jobs strictly sequentially with no parallel branches.

help.text: Parallelize independent jobs such as linting, unit testing, and security scanning to reduce pipeline cycle time.

shortDescription.text: Workflow run block interpolates untrusted event context or writes to GITHUB_ENV/PATH.

help.text: Pass untrusted GitHub context values through intermediate step 'env:' variables, quote shell expansions, and avoid writing untrusted data to $GITHUB_ENV or $GITHUB_PATH.
Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
Remove hardcoded credential and use secret management.
